crop.notes: Crop holds 'A Promising Fighter' (the Allen mention) plus a following unrelated paragraph on San Francisco fights (Dempsey, Hallinan, Maynard) from the same Gazette column.

ocr.notes: First item reads well; the San Francisco paragraph is rough in places.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Wednesday, July 29, 1885, page 5. Item credited to the Gazette.

notes: Allen is only named by an eyewitness who saw Goss and Allen fight; no citable fact about Allen.
